simple.meaning: שִׁשִּׁי (shishshîy) is a Hebrew object word meaning “sixth , ordinal or (feminine) fractional.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Genesis 1:31. The surrounding context includes family line.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שִׁשִּׁי (H8345) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: שִׁשִּׁי (shishshîy) / H8345 is traced through Genesis 1:31, Genesis 30:19, Exodus 16:5, Exodus 16:22 with generated occurrence evidence.
